en.title: Jesus' Greatest Rescue
story: Baby Jesus grew up and did amazing things. He healed people, calmed storms and loved everyone. But some leaders were jealous and angry with Jesus. They didn’t believe he was God’s Son.

One sad day, they arrested Jesus and put him on a wooden cross to die. Jesus had never done anything wrong, not even once! So why did he let it happen? Jesus could have called a million angels to help him. But he chose to stay on the cross, because of love.

Remember the wall that sin puts between us and God? On the cross, Jesus took all the wrong things we have ever done onto himself, so we could be forgiven. It was like a friend stepping in to take the blame for us. On the cross, Jesus even prayed for the people hurting him: ‘Father, forgive them.’
Then Jesus died, and his friends put his body in a tomb, a cave cut into rock. They were so sad. But wait… this is not the end of the story!

verse.text: God showed his great love for us by sending Christ to die for us while we were still sinners.

lessons: Jesus chose the cross because he loves us.
Jesus took the punishment for our wrong things so we can be forgiven.
Jesus forgave even the people who hurt him.
questions: How does it make you feel that Jesus loves you that much?
The cross is now a sign of God’s love. Where have you seen crosses?
prayer: Dear Jesus,
thank you for loving me so much
that you died on the cross for me.
Thank you for taking away my sin. Amen.

mission.text: Make a cross with two sticks or two crayons to remind you of Jesus’ love.

af.title: Jesus se Grootste Redding
story: Baba Jesus het grootgeword en wonderlike dinge gedoen. Hy het mense gesond gemaak, storms laat bedaar en almal liefgehad. Maar ’n paar leiers was jaloers en kwaad vir Jesus. Hulle het nie geglo Hy is God se Seun nie.

Op ’n hartseer dag het hulle Jesus gevang en Hom aan ’n houtkruis gesit om te sterf. Jesus het nog nooit iets verkeerd gedoen nie, nie eens een keer nie! Hoekom het Hy dit dan laat gebeur? Jesus kon ’n miljoen engele geroep het om Hom te help. Maar Hy het gekies om aan die kruis te bly, uit liefde.

Onthou jy die muur wat sonde tussen ons en God sit? Aan die kruis het Jesus al die verkeerde dinge wat ons nog ooit gedoen het, op Hom geneem, sodat ons vergewe kan word. Dit was soos ’n vriend wat instap en die skuld vir ons vat. Aan die kruis het Jesus selfs gebid vir die mense wat Hom seergemaak het: ‘Vader, vergewe hulle.’
Toe het Jesus gesterf, en sy vriende het sy liggaam in ’n graf gesit, ’n grot wat in die rots uitgekap is. Hulle was so hartseer. Maar wag… dit is nie die einde van die storie nie!

verse.text: God het sy groot liefde vir ons bewys deurdat Christus vir ons gesterf het toe ons nog sondaars was.

lessons: Jesus het die kruis gekies omdat Hy ons liefhet.
Jesus het die straf vir ons verkeerde dinge gevat sodat ons vergewe kan word.
Jesus het selfs die mense vergewe wat Hom seergemaak het.
questions: Hoe laat dit jou voel dat Jesus jou so baie liefhet?
Die kruis is nou ’n teken van God se liefde. Waar het jy al kruise gesien?
prayer: Liewe Jesus,
dankie dat U my so liefhet
dat U aan die kruis vir my gesterf het.
Dankie dat U my sonde wegneem. Amen.

mission.text: Maak ’n kruis met twee stokkies of twee kryte om jou aan Jesus se liefde te herinner.

trait.en: Jesus loves me so much that he gave his life for me
trait.af: Jesus het my so lief dat Hy sy lewe vir my gegee het

en.title: He Is Alive!
story: Early on Sunday morning, three days after Jesus died, some women went to the tomb. They were sad, and they wondered, ‘Who will roll away the huge stone from the door?’

But when they got there, RUMBLE! The earth shook, and the stone was already rolled away! An angel was sitting on it, shining as bright as lightning. ‘Don’t be afraid,’ said the angel. ‘I know you are looking for Jesus. He is not here. He has risen, just as he said!’
The tomb was EMPTY! The women ran to tell the disciples, scared and joyful all at once. And on the way, guess who met them? JESUS! Alive! They fell at his feet and worshipped him.
Jesus beat death! He is stronger than anything. And because he is alive, everyone who trusts in him will live forever with God too.

verse.text: He is not here; he has risen, just as he said!

lessons: Jesus is alive! He came back to life.
Jesus is stronger than death, sin and anything scary.
Because Jesus lives, we can be with God forever.
questions: How do you think the women felt when they saw Jesus?
Let’s shout it together: ‘Jesus is ALIVE!’
prayer: Dear Jesus,
you are alive!
You beat sin and death.
Thank you that I can live with you forever. Amen.

mission.text: Tell someone tomorrow: ‘Jesus is alive!’

af.title: Hy Leef!
story: Vroeg op Sondagoggend, drie dae nadat Jesus gesterf het, het ’n paar vroue na die graf gegaan. Hulle was hartseer, en hulle het gewonder: ‘Wie sal die groot klip van die deur af wegrol?’

Maar toe hulle daar kom, RUMMEL! Die aarde het geskud, en die klip was al weggerol! ’n Engel het daarop gesit, so helder soos weerlig. ‘Moenie bang wees nie,’ het die engel gesê. ‘Ek weet julle soek na Jesus. Hy is nie hier nie. Hy het opgestaan, net soos Hy gesê het!’
Die graf was LEEG! Die vroue het gehardloop om die dissipels te vertel, bang en baie bly gelyk. En op pad, raai wie het hulle ontmoet? JESUS! Lewend! Hulle het by sy voete neergeval en Hom aanbid.
Jesus het die dood oorwin! Hy is sterker as enigiets. En omdat Hy leef, sal almal wat Hom vertrou, ook vir altyd by God lewe.

verse.text: Hy is nie hier nie; Hy het opgestaan, net soos Hy gesê het!

lessons: Jesus leef! Hy het weer lewendig geword.
Jesus is sterker as die dood, sonde en enigiets wat bang maak.
Omdat Jesus leef, kan ons vir altyd by God wees.
questions: Hoe dink jy het die vroue gevoel toe hulle Jesus sien?
Kom ons skree dit saam: ‘Jesus LEEF!’
prayer: Liewe Jesus,
U leef!
U het sonde en die dood oorwin.
Dankie dat ek vir altyd by U kan lewe. Amen.

mission.text: Sê môre vir iemand: ‘Jesus leef!’

en.title: Breakfast on the Beach
story: Before Jesus died, his friend Peter had done something that made him very sad. Three times, people asked him, ‘Do you know Jesus?’ And three times, Peter was scared and said, ‘No! I don’t know him!’ Afterwards Peter cried and cried.

After Jesus came back to life, Peter went fishing with his friends. They fished all night and caught nothing (sound familiar?). In the morning, a man on the beach called, ‘Throw your net on the right side!’ They did, and the net filled with 153 fish! ‘It’s the Lord!’ said John. Peter was so excited that he jumped into the water and swam to shore!

Jesus had made a fire and was cooking breakfast. After they ate, Jesus asked Peter, ‘Peter, do you love me?’ ‘Yes, Lord, you know I love you.’ Jesus asked him three times, once for each time Peter had said no. Then Jesus said, ‘Take care of my sheep.’

Jesus doesn’t give up on us when we fail.

story: Voordat Jesus gesterf het, het sy vriend Petrus iets gedoen wat hom baie hartseer gemaak het. Drie keer het mense hom gevra: ‘Ken jy Jesus?’ En drie keer was Petrus bang en het gesê: ‘Nee! Ek ken Hom nie!’ Daarna het Petrus gehuil en gehuil.

en.title: Breakfast on the Beach
story: Before Jesus died, his friend Peter had done something that made him very sad. Three times, people asked him, ‘Do you know Jesus?’ And three times, Peter was scared and said, ‘No! I don’t know him!’ Afterwards Peter cried and cried.

After Jesus came back to life, Peter went fishing with his friends. They fished all night and caught nothing (sound familiar?). In the morning, a man on the beach called, ‘Throw your net on the right side!’ They did, and the net filled with 153 fish! ‘It’s the Lord!’ said John. Peter was so excited that he jumped into the water and swam to shore!

Jesus had made a fire and was cooking breakfast. After they ate, Jesus asked Peter, ‘Peter, do you love me?’ ‘Yes, Lord, you know I love you.’ Jesus asked him three times, once for each time Peter had said no. Then Jesus said, ‘Take care of my sheep.’
Jesus didn’t just forgive Peter. He gave him an important job again.

Jesus gives us a fresh start and a job to do.

thank you that you forgive me
and never give up on me.
Yes, Jesus, I love you! Amen.

mission.text: Have a special breakfast with Mom and talk about Jesus’ beach breakfast.

en.fact: Peter went on to become one of the great leaders of the early church, and he wrote two books of the Bible!
en.deeper: Jesus asked Peter three times, ‘Do you love me?’ Why do you think he asked three times?
en.journal: Answer Jesus: write ‘Yes, Lord, I love you because…’ and finish the sentence.

en.title: The Helper Comes
story: After forty days, Jesus took his friends up a hill. ‘I’m going back to my Father in heaven,’ he said. ‘But I won’t leave you alone. I will send you the Holy Spirit, the Helper.’ Then Jesus went up into the sky until a cloud hid him.

His friends waited and prayed together in a room in Jerusalem. Ten days later there was a sound like a mighty wind, WHOOOOSH, that filled the whole house. Little flames, like fire, rested on each of them, and they were filled with the Holy Spirit! Suddenly they could speak in languages they had never learned, and they bravely told everyone about Jesus. That day about 3,000 people decided to follow Jesus!
The Holy Spirit is God living inside everyone who follows Jesus. He helps us when we are sad, makes us brave, reminds us of what Jesus said and helps us do what is right.
You never have to go anywhere without God.

verse.text: I will ask the Father, and he will give you another Helper to be with you forever.

lessons: The Holy Spirit is God living in those who follow Jesus.
The Holy Spirit helps us, comforts us and makes us brave.
We never have to be alone.
questions: What would you like the Holy Spirit to help you with?
You can’t see the wind, but you can see what it does. How is the Holy Spirit like that?
prayer: Dear God,
thank you for the Holy Spirit, my Helper.
Please fill me and help me
to be kind, brave and good. Amen.

mission.text: Blow bubbles or watch the wind in the trees, and remember the Holy Spirit.

af.title: Die Helper Kom
story: Ná veertig dae het Jesus sy vriende teen ’n heuwel op geneem. ‘Ek gaan terug na my Vader in die hemel,’ het Hy gesê. ‘Maar Ek sal julle nie alleen los nie. Ek sal vir julle die Heilige Gees stuur, die Helper.’ Toe gaan Jesus op in die lug totdat ’n wolk Hom weggesteek het.

Sy vriende het gewag en saam gebid in ’n kamer in Jerusalem. Tien dae later was daar ’n geluid soos ’n sterk wind, WOEESJ, wat die hele huis gevul het. Klein vlammetjies, soos vuur, het op elkeen van hulle gerus, en hulle is met die Heilige Gees vervul! Skielik kon hulle in tale praat wat hulle nooit geleer het nie, en hulle het almal dapper van Jesus vertel. Daardie dag het omtrent 3 000 mense besluit om Jesus te volg!
Die Heilige Gees is God wat woon in almal wat Jesus volg. Hy help ons as ons hartseer is, maak ons dapper, herinner ons aan wat Jesus gesê het en help ons om reg te doen.
Jy hoef nooit sonder God enige plek heen te gaan nie.

verse.text: Ek sal die Vader vra, en Hy sal julle ’n ander Helper gee om vir altyd by julle te wees.

lessons: Die Heilige Gees is God wat woon in die wat Jesus volg.
Die Heilige Gees help ons, troos ons en maak ons dapper.
Ons hoef nooit alleen te wees nie.
questions: Waarmee wil jy hê moet die Heilige Gees jou help?
Jy kan nie die wind sien nie, maar jy kan sien wat dit doen. Hoe is die Heilige Gees so?
prayer: Liewe God,
dankie vir die Heilige Gees, my Helper.
Vul my asseblief en help my
om gaaf, dapper en goed te wees. Amen.

mission.text: Blaas borrels of kyk hoe die wind in die bome waai, en onthou die Heilige Gees.

af.deeper: Die vrug van die Gees is liefde, blydskap, vrede, geduld, vriendelikheid, goedheid, getrouheid, sagmoedigheid en selfbeheersing (Galasiërs 5:22–23). Watter een wil jy meer van hê?

en.title: Go and Tell the World!
story: Before Jesus went back to heaven, he gathered his friends on a mountain and gave them the biggest adventure mission ever!

‘Go to all the people in the world,’ he said, ‘and make them my followers. Baptise them, and teach them to obey everything I have taught you.’ That is a huge job! The whole world? How could a few friends do that?
Then Jesus gave them the best promise of all: ‘And remember, I am with you always, to the very end.’

And they did it! They told people, who told more people, who told more people… for 2,000 years! The good news travelled across seas and mountains and deserts, until one day someone told your family, and now Mom is telling you! You are part of Jesus’ great adventure. And the best part? Jesus is with you every step of the way.

verse.text: And surely I am with you always, to the very end.

lessons: Jesus gave his followers a mission: tell the world about him.
The good news has been passed on for 2,000 years, all the way to you!
Jesus is always with us on his mission.
questions: Who told Mom about Jesus? (Mom, share your story!)
Who could you tell?
prayer: Dear Jesus,
thank you that you are always with me.
Send me on your adventure.
Help me tell others about you. Amen.

mission.text: Invite a friend to church, or tell them a Bible story you learned.

af.title: Gaan Vertel die Wêreld!
story: Voordat Jesus teruggegaan het hemel toe, het Hy sy vriende op ’n berg bymekaargemaak en vir hulle die grootste avontuuropdrag ooit gegee!

‘Gaan na al die mense in die wêreld,’ het Hy gesê, ‘en maak hulle my volgelinge. Doop hulle, en leer hulle om alles te doen wat Ek julle geleer het.’ Dit is ’n reuse werk! Die hele wêreld? Hoe kon ’n paar vriende dit doen?
Toe gee Jesus hulle die beste belofte van almal: ‘En onthou, Ek is by julle al die dae, tot aan die einde.’

En hulle het dit gedoen! Hulle het mense vertel, wat meer mense vertel het, wat nog meer mense vertel het… 2 000 jaar lank! Die goeie nuus het oor see en berge en woestyne gereis, totdat iemand eendag jou familie vertel het, en nou vertel Mamma vir jou! Jy is deel van Jesus se groot avontuur. En die beste deel? Jesus is by jou op elke tree van die pad.

verse.text: En onthou, Ek is by julle al die dae tot aan die einde.

lessons: Jesus het sy volgelinge ’n opdrag gegee: vertel die wêreld van Hom.
Die goeie nuus is 2 000 jaar lank aangegee, tot by jou!
Jesus is altyd by ons op sy opdrag.
questions: Wie het vir Mamma van Jesus vertel? (Mamma, vertel jou storie!)
Vir wie kan jy vertel?
prayer: Liewe Jesus,
dankie dat U altyd by my is.
Stuur my op u avontuur.
Help my om ander van U te vertel. Amen.

mission.text: Nooi ’n maatjie kerk toe, of vertel hulle ’n Bybelstorie wat jy geleer het.

en.title: Grand Campfire: The Adventure Has Only Begun
story: You did it, explorer! You have walked the whole trail. You have collected treasure after treasure about who God is: Creator, Holy, Mighty, Good, Kind, King, Friend, Saviour. But this is not the end. Being a child of God and a friend of Jesus is an adventure that lasts forever.
questions: What is your very favourite thing you learned about God?
What do you want to say to God tonight?
prayer: Dear God,
thank you for the Lantern Trail.
Thank you for showing me who you are.
I want to keep knowing you better and better,
every day of my life. Amen.

mission.text: Keep using the Friendship Compass every day: Talk, Listen, Trust, Love.

story: Jy het dit gedoen, ontdekker! Jy het die hele pad gestap. Jy het skat ná skat versamel oor wie God is: Skepper, Heilig, Magtig, Goed, Vriendelik, Koning, Vriend, Verlosser. Maar dit is nie die einde nie. Om ’n kind van God en ’n vriend van Jesus te wees, is ’n avontuur wat vir altyd hou.
questions: Wat is die heel beste ding wat jy oor God geleer het?
Wat wil jy vanaand vir God sê?
prayer: Liewe God,
dankie vir die Lanternpad.
Dankie dat U my gewys het wie U is.
Ek wil U elke dag van my lewe
beter en beter leer ken. Amen.
